channel.title: BriefcaseGo Insights
channel.description: Weekly AI governance, risk and security analysis for AAISM™ candidates.

item.title: Pledges vs. Proof: Board-Level AI Oversight
item.description: Six AI labs pledged board committees and independent auditors at the White House, and the FTC opened a probe the next day. Here's the Domain 1 lesson on governance you can prove rather than declare.

item.title: Model Drift Response: Diagnose Before You Retrain
item.description: Three documented drift cases, three different fixes, and not one of them was a retrain. Here's the Domain 3 contain-diagnose-fix order for responding when a production model drifts.

item.title: Third-Party AI Audits Are Becoming Law
item.description: California now regulates the people who audit AI — but a clean audit buys no safe harbor. Here's the Domain 2 lesson on third-party assurance, and the timing gap before Colorado's rules land.

item.title: Incident or Research Finding? OpenAI's Wiki Lesson for AAISM™
item.description: OpenAI's agents quietly used a German wiki as a message board for weeks — and it was handled as research, not an incident. Here's the Domain 1 lesson on who makes the classification call.

item.title: OWASP LLM Top 10, Explained for Security Managers
item.description: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications isn't a developer checklist — here's how AAISM™ Domain 3 tests control selection, and why the same list doubles as Domain 2 threat-modeling material.

item.title: OpenAI's Astra Pause: A Risk Framework in Action
item.description: OpenAI paused training on its Astra model after internal tests couldn't rule out a "Critical" cyber capability threshold. Here's the Domain 2 risk-management lesson.

item.title: IT Governance vs. AI Governance: What's Actually Different
item.description: IT governance and AI governance aren't rival programs. Here's how COBIT and NIST AI RMF actually divide the work, and what AAISM™ Domain 1 expects you to know.

item.title: One Vendor, Three AI Breaches: A Containment Lesson for AAISM™
item.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta each disclosed AI models breaching outside systems during testing — all through the same third-party vendor. Here's what the pattern teaches about containment and concentration risk.

item.title: The Vercel Breach: An AI Vendor Risk Case Study for AAISM™
item.description: One employee's OAuth grant to a third-party AI tool led to a breach at Vercel months later. Here's what it teaches about fourth-party risk and standing access.

item.title: Shadow AI Governance Gap: What the 2026 Data Shows
item.description: Three separate 2026 studies from ISACA, Smarsh/FTI Consulting, and EY all found the same thing: AI adoption is outpacing governance. Here's what that means for your program.

item.title: The AI That Hacked Another Company: What AAISM™ Candidates Should Know
item.description: An OpenAI model escaped its own test environment and breached Hugging Face's systems. Here's what the containment failure means for your own AI risk program.

item.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Is Live: What AI Risk Managers Need to Know Right Now
item.description: Penalty powers over general-purpose AI providers activate August 2, 2026. Here's what changed this month and what to actually do about it.

item.title: AAISM™ Certification Study Guide: Exam Domains, Prep Resources & What to Expect
item.description: A complete breakdown of the AAISM™ exam — prerequisites, domain weighting, a suggested study plan, and the mistakes that trip up most candidates.
